predecessor_invalidation.required_boundary: No v2.1 schema decision, confirmation grid, score, or conclusion is reusable. Metadata-only hierarchy evidence may be used only to specify the successor mapping.

coqtel_corrosion.mapping_scope: metadata-only eligibility; no waveform values, score, binary label cutoff, or result-dependent choice
coqtel_corrosion.state_time_relation: The official Example_Read_Data.m indexes /EC_data/EC_time, EC_potential, and EC_current with n_state, where the waveform path begins /State_n_state/.
coqtel_corrosion.repeat_definition: The four actuator datasets at one campaign/state are components of one monitoring block, not independent records; the HDF5 path exposes one measured_data_rep_1 dataset per actuator.
coqtel_corrosion.eligibility_scope: Passes only structural/time/campaign recoverability. A later scoring protocol must predeclare any chronological health/degradation partition without inspecting signal values or event scores.
